sectors.name: Renewables & Climate-Tech
themes: Indonesia's mandatory biodiesel (B35) and upcoming carbon tax are driving durable demand for biofuel and carbon-credit-linked assets like ARKO and CDIA.
Government push for 23% renewable energy mix by 2025 creates captive demand for geothermal and solar developers (TPIA, BREN) amid coal phase-down commitments.
US IRA-linked supply chain reshoring benefits Indonesian nickel-based battery storage plays (BRPT, PLUG), leveraging domestic critical mineral dominance.
sectors.ai: Indonesia's renewables rally (+3.24%) signals accelerating domestic policy tailwinds and foreign capital rotation into climate-tech; overweight TPIA and BREN for structural grid decarbonization plays, as ARKO's 18% surge hints at M&A speculation in the sub-sector.

sectors.name: Consumer & FMCG
themes: Rising middle-class disposable income in Indonesia continues to drive premiumization in protein and packaged food categories, benefiting names like BEEF and COCO.
Government infrastructure spending and minimum wage hikes are boosting rural purchasing power, creating durable demand for affordable FMCG staples such as FLMC and LUCY.
E-commerce and digital channel penetration is accelerating distribution for smaller consumer brands, enabling rapid market share gains for agile players like AGAR and HAS.
sectors.ai: Indonesia consumer stocks rallied sharply today, led by AGAR (+24.75%) and BEEF (+13.33%), signaling strong domestic demand momentum. With the sector up 0.81% locally versus flat US peers, overweight selective mid-cap names exposed to protein and staples, as structural consumption tailwinds remain intact despite global headwinds.

sectors.name: Crypto & Digital Assets
themes: Indonesia's crypto adoption is structurally driven by a young, tech-savvy population with high mobile penetration, making digital assets a durable alternative to traditional banking.
Regulatory clarity from Bappebti, including potential stablecoin frameworks, is a long-term catalyst for institutional and retail participation in the local crypto market.
Global DeFi and layer-1 token momentum (UNI, ADA, DOT) aligns with Indonesia's growing interest in yield-generating assets, supported by rising local exchange volumes.
sectors.ai: Indonesia's crypto rally, led by ONDO and VVV, signals renewed risk appetite despite regulatory uncertainty. Watch for Bappebti's stance on stablecoins (STABLE +6.80%) and DeFi tokens (UNI +6.21%), as local exchange liquidity tightens. Position for selective altcoin exposure, but hedge with ADA and DOT for relative stability amid global macro headwinds.
